subject: Barcelona and Real Madrid chase Brighton's Luka Vuskovic, 46 million pounds in the summer
title: Vuskovic: Barca and Real want him

lines.vo: Barcelona and Real Madrid agree on nothing. Except this nineteen-year-old.
Brighton's Luka Vuskovic is a Croatian centre-back, and both giants are chasing him.
The press already calls him the new Rodri. He is nineteen. No pressure.
ESPN says Brighton signed him from Tottenham this summer for forty-six million pounds. Tottenham can now watch the bidding from the sofa.
His contract runs to June twenty-thirty-one. Brighton are expected to listen to offers at the end of the season.
Brighton are in no hurry. Neither is the price tag.
